svg.text: Text outside component outlines is intended PCB silkscreen; text inside is drawing annotation.
• both 75×150-mm panels use the same millimetre scale
• every solid component envelope comes from the MPN register
• raised U214 rail, vertical host socket and Keystone holder all fit
• exact components clear all M2.5 hole/head keep-outs
• both RF connector banks mount on the outward PCB faces
↑ / ↓ / ← / → interface faces through that enclosure edge
⊗ / ⊙ press toward / remove away from the viewed face
○ / ≋ microphone port and speaker grille are locations, not signal directions
physical actual-TX evidence for each transmitting path
Eight path indicators plus TX ACTIVE form one front line below the display.
Labels match antenna use: WI-FI/BLE, WI-FI/15.4, nRF24-1..3, SUB-GHz, VHF/UHF and IR.
orange dashed — open custom enclosure drawing
violet — custom product part; supplier MPN does not apply
RF connectors are outward-face bodies with barrels and hex nuts.
SMA: GCT RFPC-SMA31-FN-175-A · 6 GHz · IP67 · 1.6-mm PCB.
RP-SMA: GCT RFPC-SMA32-FN-175-A · same panel cut-out.
Cap-Bus host: Samtec SSW-107-02-S-D · 2×7 · 2.54 mm · vertical.
Dimensioned projection — not an enclosure release drawing.
D-pad cross is custom over Alps SKRHADE010; its control drawing replaces a cap MPN.
Davies 1227-J is the exact encoder knob; only its fit HIL remains.
BACK/OPT/F1/F2/PTT are direct buttons; D-pad is one SKRH switch and one cross.
The side C&K JS102011SCQN is the sole RUN/KILL and source-command control.
